verdicts.reason: A cuts the photo down to a short strip hanging from the top edge. The praying hands, the key image, are cropped almost entirely away, the crosses float faintly on white outside the photo, and the cloud outlines on the left are ghostly white-on-white shapes in a big dead area. B keeps more of the hands and the cross, but its white text panel bites a hard rectangular notch out of the photo, the column is pinned to the centre while the left third is empty except for the invisible cloud outlines, and the quote sits off-axis from the image. Both are poor; B is slightly better because more of the original imagery survives.
